hints.title: Homomorphism of Parity
hints.text: The parity of bits in x bitwise xor y bitwise xor z is (parity(x) + parity(y) + parity(z)) % 2.

hints.title: Large Array Partitioning
hints.text: Count elements with even and odd bit counts in each array using 64-bit integer counters.

hints.title: Four Product Terms
hints.text: Multiply matching counts: (ea * eb * ec) + (ea * ob * oc) + (oa * eb * oc) + (oa * ob * ec).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Triple loop takes O(na * nb * nc) = 10^15 operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bit count parity homomorphism and 64-bit arithmetic.
